name: Race
definition: A single Formula 1 Grand Prix event, identified by a surrogate raceId, held in one season year at one round number at exactly one circuit.
scope: Race identification, calendar and season analysis over the races table (1950-2017).

name: Circuit
definition: A permanent or street racing venue at which Grand Prix events are held; carries a name, a location, a host country and geographic coordinates.
scope: Venue and geography analysis over the circuits table.

name: Driver
definition: A person who drove in at least one Grand Prix, identified by driverId and described by driverRef, code, forename, surname, date of birth and nationality.
scope: Driver-level analysis over the drivers table.

name: Constructor
definition: A team or entrant that entered cars in Grand Prix racing, identified by constructorId and described by constructorRef, name, nationality and a reference URL.
scope: Team-level analysis over the constructors table.

name: Constructor Reference Name
definition: The short stable reference slug of a constructor, such as 'toyota' or 'super_aguri'; it is the constructor counterpart of the driver and circuit reference names.
scope: Questions that ask for a constructor reference name rather than the team display name.

name: Season
definition: A championship year, keyed by the integer year, that groups all races of that year and carries the season reference URL.
scope: Season-level aggregation over the seasons table (68 seasons).

name: Race Result Entry
definition: The performance record of one driver with one constructor in one race, holding grid slot, finishing position, classification order, points, laps completed, finish time, status and fastest-lap facts.
scope: Central fact row of the schema; grain is one driver per race (23657 rows over 976 races).

name: Lap Time Record
definition: The time recorded by one driver on one lap of one race, keyed by the combination of race, driver and lap number, with the running track position on that lap.
scope: Per-lap timing analysis over the lapTimes table (420369 rows).

name: Qualifying Result
definition: One driver's qualifying performance in one race, holding the qualifying classification position and the best lap time of each qualifying segment (q1, q2, q3).
scope: Qualifying analysis over the qualifying table (7397 rows).

name: Constructor Race Result
definition: The points a constructor scored at one race, one row per constructor per race, including races where the constructor scored zero points.
scope: Constructor-per-race scoring analysis over the constructorResults table (11082 rows).

name: Driver Standing
definition: A driver's cumulative championship position after a given race of a season, with cumulative points, position text and cumulative wins.
scope: Championship progression analysis over the driverStandings table.

name: Constructor Standing
definition: A constructor's cumulative championship position after a given race of a season, with cumulative points, position text and cumulative wins.
scope: Constructor championship progression analysis over the constructorStandings table.

name: Race Status
definition: The outcome category recorded for a result entry, expressed as human-readable text such as 'Finished', '+1 Lap', 'Accident', 'Engine', 'Disqualified', 'Did not qualify'.
scope: Interpretation of why a driver did or did not complete a race; joined through statusId.

name: Finisher Status
definition: The subset of race-status values that denote a classified finish: the status text 'Finished' (statusId = 1).
scope: Used when a question asks for drivers who finished or completed a race; distinct from statuses such as '+1 Lap' or 'Did not qualify'.

name: Driver Nationality
definition: The sporting nationality of a driver, stored as an English country adjective such as 'British', 'Japanese', 'German', 'French', 'Dutch'.
scope: Filtering or grouping drivers by country of sporting nationality.

name: Constructor Nationality
definition: The sporting nationality of a constructor, stored with the same English country-adjective vocabulary used for drivers.
scope: Filtering or grouping constructors by nationality.

name: Circuit Country
definition: The country in which a circuit is physically located, stored as an English country name such as 'Germany', 'Japan', 'UK'.
scope: Host-country analysis of races; must not be confused with the Grand Prix name of a race.

name: Circuit Location
definition: The town, city or area name where a circuit is situated, such as 'Hockenheim', 'Marina Bay', 'Adelaide'.
scope: Describing where a Grand Prix was hosted at locality level.

name: Circuit Coordinates
definition: The geographic position of a circuit expressed as a latitude and a longitude pair, with an optional altitude.
scope: Spatial description of a venue; 'coordinate position' or 'location coordinates' in a question refers to this pair.

name: Circuit Name
definition: The full human-readable name of a circuit, such as 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' or 'Hockenheimring'.
scope: Identifying a venue by its official name.

name: Circuit Reference Name
definition: The short stable reference slug of a circuit, such as 'marina_bay'; it is the circuit counterpart of the driver and constructor reference names.
scope: Questions asking for a 'reference name' of a circuit.

name: Race Name
definition: The official Grand Prix title of a race, such as 'European Grand Prix' or 'Malaysian Grand Prix'; the same title is reused across seasons at different circuits.
scope: Race-title filtering and host-country breakdowns; a Grand Prix title is not a country.

name: Race Date
definition: The calendar date on which a race was held, stored as an ISO date; it supports year, month and exact-day filtering.
scope: Temporal filtering of races by year, month or exact day.

name: Season Year
definition: The four-digit championship year of a race; it is consistent with the calendar year of the race date and is the key of the seasons table.
scope: Filtering races, results and standings by season.

name: Race Round
definition: The sequential position of a race within its season calendar, restarting at 1 each year.
scope: Ordering and identifying races inside a season; it is a calendar ordinal, not a global race identifier.

name: Driver Full Name
definition: The personal name of a driver formed by joining the forename and the surname; it is the name a question means by 'full name of the driver' or 'racer'.
scope: Presenting or matching a driver by personal name rather than by reference name or code.

name: Driver Reference Name
definition: The short stable slug identifying a driver, such as 'hamilton' or 'max_verstappen'; it is what questions mean by the driver's 'reference name' or 'reference names'.
scope: Questions asking for a driver reference or reference name.

name: Driver Code
definition: The three-letter abbreviated driver code, such as 'HAM', 'VET', 'VER'; it is the abbreviated identifier, distinct from the reference slug.
scope: Questions asking for an abbreviated or three-letter driver code; only drivers active in the modern era carry one.

name: Driver Date of Birth
definition: The driver's date of birth, stored as an ISO date and used to derive age ordering such as oldest or youngest driver.
scope: Age-based ranking and birth-year filtering of drivers.

name: Driver Age
definition: The derived age of a driver, obtained by comparing the driver's date of birth with a reference date; age ordering is the intent behind the words oldest and youngest.
scope: Age comparisons and extreme-age selection; no age column exists and it must be derived from the birth date.

name: Race Points
definition: Championship points scored by a driver or by a constructor in a single race; historical scoring rules produce fractional values.
scope: Per-race scoring, including identifying scoreless entries.

name: Championship Standing Points
definition: The cumulative championship points total of a driver or constructor after a given race of a season; it is a running total, not a per-race score.
scope: Reading a points total from the standings tables; distinct in grain from per-race points.

name: Championship Position
definition: A driver's or constructor's cumulative ranking in the championship after a given race, recorded both as a number and as a position text.
scope: Determining who leads or wins a championship at a given point of a season.

name: Wins
definition: The number of races won by a driver or constructor, either counted from race victories or read from the cumulative wins counter of the standings tables.
scope: Questions about the most winning driver or team.

name: Season Champion
definition: The driver or constructor that finishes a season at championship position 1, i.e. the leader of the standings after the final round of that season.
scope: Questions about the champion of a given year, as opposed to the winner of one race.

name: Race Winner
definition: The driver classified first in a single race; in the result data this is the entry with classification order 1 and the only entry whose finish time is an absolute race duration rather than a gap.
scope: Identifying the winner or champion of one specific Grand Prix.

name: Race Finish Time
definition: The finishing time recorded for a result entry, stored both as a display string and as a millisecond value; for the winner it is the total race duration, for other classified finishers it is the elapsed time from the race start.
scope: Measuring when a driver finished; the presence of this value separates classified finishers from non-finishers.

name: Race Completion
definition: The condition of a driver having completed and been classified in a race, established by the presence of a race finish time on the result entry.
scope: Questions about finishing, completing or taking part successfully in a race.

name: Race Completion Rate
definition: The proportion of result entries that represent a completed race, computed as the count of entries with a finish time divided by the total count of entries in the same population.
scope: Percentage-style questions about how often a group of drivers finished their races.

name: Finish Position
definition: The final classified position of a driver in a race, recorded as text that is either the classification number, 'R' for retired, or 'F' for a non-starting entry.
scope: Reading the finishing classification of a result entry.

name: Classification Order
definition: The strictly numeric ordering of all result entries of a race, defined for every entry including those that were not classified, which makes it the reliable ordering key for taking the first row of a race.
scope: Ordering result entries when determining first, top or best placements.

name: Grid Position
definition: The starting slot of a driver on the race grid; the value 0 denotes that the driver started from the pit lane rather than from a numbered grid slot.
scope: Comparing starting position with finishing position.

name: Laps Completed
definition: The number of race laps a driver completed in a race; entries that never started record zero laps.
scope: Race distance analysis and lap-count based thresholds.

name: Lap Time
definition: The duration of one lap by one driver in one race, stored both as a display duration and as a millisecond value; the millisecond form is the comparable numeric representation.
scope: Lap-by-lap pacing analysis, including averages and thresholds.

name: Fastest Lap Time
definition: The best lap time a driver achieved in a race, either precomputed on the result entry or derivable as the minimum lap time among that driver's lap records for the race.
scope: Questions about a driver's fastest lap or the fastest lap of a race.

name: Fastest Lap Lap Number
definition: The lap number on which a driver set their fastest lap of a race, recorded as the fastest-lap index on the result entry.
scope: Questions about which lap a fastest lap was set on, phrased as the fastest lap number.

name: Fastest Lap Rank
definition: The rank of a driver's fastest lap among all fastest laps of the same race; rank 1 means the driver set the fastest lap of the race.
scope: Selecting the driver who set the fastest lap of a race or ranking drivers by their quickest lap.

name: Fastest Lap Speed
definition: The average speed achieved on the driver's fastest lap of a race, expressed in kilometres per hour.
scope: Speed-based comparison of fastest laps.

name: Qualifying Lap Time
definition: The best lap time a driver set in a qualifying segment of a race weekend; the segments q1, q2 and q3 are successive knockout sessions, and a segment is empty when the driver did not take part in it.
scope: Qualifying performance analysis and qualifying time matching.

name: Qualifying Position
definition: The classification position of a driver in the qualifying session of a race, one sequential position per driver per race.
scope: Determining who qualified first or which qualifying session a driver reached.

name: Reference URL
definition: The externally resolvable reference link attached to a season, race, circuit, driver or constructor record; it is what a question asking for a website points at.
scope: Retrieving the official or reference web page of an entity.
